end.parentNote: Asha practised exact versus approximate values, rounding to lakh and thousand, and estimating rounding error. Ayaan used the halfway point to round 5,62,300 to 6 lakh and 1,968 to 2,000, and checked a rounding difference by addition. They first rounded 7,49,999 up to 8 lakh, then corrected it to 7 lakh; the place-value mix-up with 3,26,400 was also corrected later. At home, ask Ayaan to explain which digit decides rounding in two large-number examples.
